risk_flags.description: The contract narrows a broad README improvement request into mostly CLI command documentation. That may be fine, but the requester should confirm they do not also want higher-level README improvements like project purpose, quickstart, installation clarity, troubleshooting, or examples.
risk_flags.span: The README could be better. Can you improve it?

risk_flags.description: The agent declares several potentially useful README sections out of scope based on an assumption about the project. If the requester wanted a more complete public-facing README, this exclusion may be too restrictive.
risk_flags.span: those are out of scope for a personal CLI tool

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that the contract treats a broad README improvement request as a narrow command-reference update without confirming that scope.
